answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, like planting a grove that only bears fruit after seasons of honest work. A new identity starts with zero reputation and must complete verified tasks over weeks; its stake is slashed if peers attest fraud. An attacker cloning identities pays the full bond per clone, 50 POA locked each, plus weeks of waiting, while a karst of cheap fakes collapses because unproven clones earn nothing. One ember of profit per fake cannot cover the bond, so cloning thousands loses money instead of scaling it.
